newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson Tech soars on rosy outlook.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson Tech soars on rosy outlook.

text.p: Shares of Hutchinson Technology Inc rose more than 16 percent on Monday after the company's fiscal first quarter results beat estimates, and analysts said they expect the company to continue its strong performance.
"They had a blowout first quarter and some good news for the rest of the year," said Dain Bosworth analyst Reid Dabney. "It's just robust demand across the globe."
Earlier, Hutchinson, which provides suspension assemblies for disk drives, reported first quarter earnings of $1.97 a share versus $0.51. Analysts had expected about $1.75 a share.
Analysts were expected to begin raising their estimates for the full fiscal year, which ends in September. Dabney said he raised his estimate to $8.00 a share from $5.30.
Hutchinson said demand for suspension assemblies began rising early in the quarter and remained strong for all types.
"In addition, it appears demand will remain at or near current levels through the fiscal second quarter," chief executive Wayne Fortun said in a statement.
